text:
elaine (product): quick sync — we need a tight decision for the enterprise evidence playbook. Sales/legal want clarity on: audit-log retention tiers, BYOK/key-retention semantics during legal holds, SOC2/ISO evidence bundle contents, and the launch acceptance checklist.

omar (eng): proposed MVP: retention tiers = hot (30d search), warm (180d short-term), cold (7y archive). add schema fields: `legal_hold_id`, `retention_tier`, `requester_org`. New exports emit manifest_v1 next to archive. No automatic backfill for old logs; generate manifest-on-demand for legacy.

priya (security): SOC2 / ISO asks: signed manifest inside the archive, per-object checksum, signing_key_fingerprint, signer_audit_id, and chain-of-custody (requester_email + issued_at). For BYOK: include `customer_keystore_id` and `kms_key_version`; if customer denies escrow, require customer verification key or document escrow implications. Acceptance: security validates 3 sample bundles (BYOK w/cust key, BYOK no-escrow, standard) and verifies signatures+checksums.

ben (sales): customers push for SLAs: targeted export ready within 48h, scoped full export within 10 days. They also require key rotation guarantees: preserve key metadata and reference to the version used to encrypt exports for at least 3 years. Flag: some gov customers want proof-of-storage (signed manifest + checksums).

tia (ops): ops constraints: exports create big egress/CPU spikes. plan: rate-limited export workers, tenant-level quota, and `exports.legal_hold_mvp` feature flag per-tenant. Canary: 3 tenants (48h) -> 20% traffic (5d) -> full. We'll surface "pending legal exports" in console and add alerts for stuck jobs. Estimate storage/meta delta +9-12%.

audit-bot: created ticket INF-4510, added canary placeholder and automated smoke export test.

elaine (product): decision checklist EOD Tue: (1) confirm retention buckets + durations, (2) sign-off on schema fields (`legal_hold_id`, `legal_hold.reason`, `requester_org`, `retention_tier`, `kms_key_version`), (3) acceptance criteria for SOC2/ISO exports (3 validated bundles), (4) canary cadence + FF plan. I'll draft a short RFC with rollout steps and an evidence export runbook.

omar (eng): small manifest example for RFC:
```json
{"manifest_version":"1","legal_hold_id":"lh_2026_01","tenant_id":"t_acme","requested_by":"legal@acme.com","issued_at":"2026-03-01T12:00:00Z","objects":[{"path":"s3://.../part-0001.gz","sha256":"abc123...","retention_tier":"search"}],"kms_key_id":"proj/t_acme/key1","kms_key_version":"v3","signatures":[{"signer":"redwood-hsm-v2","fingerprint":"aa:bb:cc","sig":"base64..."}]}
```
We'll keep manifests compact and stable.

priya (security): also require test matrix: BYOK w/customer verification key, BYOK without escrow, and standard tenant in gov region. Security will run verification within 24h of canary exports.

tia (ops): migration note: we won't backfill historical blobs by default — too risky. We'll offer a paid migration/backfill job or on-demand manifest generation for legal requests. Add FF `exports.generate_legacy_manifest_on_demand`.

elaine (product): good — I'll share RFC draft by EOD tomorrow and tag eng/security/ops for review. If no major objections we'll target feature-gated beta in next sprint. :rocket:
